title: Can You Buy Your Way to Heaven? The Truth About Spiritual Courses (1980-07-25)
description:
Spent years seeking without results? Discover why you can't pay for the Kingdom of God and how to experience the actual living process of transformation.

Shri Mataji challenges the commercialization of spirituality, explaining that the Kingdom of God is a living process that cannot be bought. She clarifies the true meaning of Yoga versus modern exercise culture and answers audience questions. Culminates in a guided meditation to awaken the Kundalini and experience inner silence.

Key Topics:
• 🌿 Why spiritual transformation is a living process like a seed sprouting - you cannot pay for it
• 💭 Human freedom vs. animal innocence: How ego leads to confusion and stupidity
• ❓ Q&A: Is Kundalini awakening just another form of yoga? The difference between Union and exercise
• 🧘‍♀️ The true meaning of 'Born Again' as a verifiable physiological event, not just a label
• ⚡ Guided self-realization experience - feel the cool breeze of the Spirit on your hands

“Truth is not to be judged by how many people follow, even if there’s half a person, it is true! Truth can guide self. If Christ was crucified that doesn’t mean that he was not the truth! He was!”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Christ promised to lead us to the Kingdom of God - are we going anywhere near it?
• Is raising the Kundalini just a form of Yoga?
• Why does Sahaja Yoga teach us to lead a moral life instead of 'liberation'?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• Why you should not pay for spiritual awakening?
• Difference between modern Hatha Yoga and traditional Yoga?
• How to experience thoughtless awareness during meditation?

Shri Mataji compares spirituality to a living seed sprouting. Did you feel that natural, spontaneous growth or cool breeze during the meditation?

---

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1980 in Enfield Civic Centre, Enfield (England).
